name: PenlyDoc API
description:
Send documents for signature from your product, show the signing page inside it, and get the signed PDF back. Step-by-step guide: [/docs](/docs). Embedding from A to Z: [/docs/embed](/docs/embed).

Authorize with your API key (Console → Developers). Keep it on your server.
